description: Creates a Tyton signup and Connect link for one website. Takes either a saved free audit (audit_id and audit_key, which brings the report along) or site_url, the customer's live https website. customer_approved records that the customer agreed to set up Tyton. Returns authorization_url for the customer, plus a private request_id and poll_token for checking the request's status. The customer can pick the free plan or a paid one; existing accounts with a plan skip that step. The link grants no access and starts no tracking by itself.

site_url.description: The customer's website (https) when there is no saved audit. The customer sees and approves it before connecting.

name: start_signup
title: Create signup link
